# Shift-delete assertions lack messages

At revision 96f004a2f25fa5b4f417983ac9e22a8f3a42be37, the shift-delete test in browser_messageCommands.js calls Assert.equal and Assert.notEqual without assertion messages. These calls need review findings when they fall within the requested review scope, under the user requirement that every assertion have a non-empty message stating the expected behavior. Nearby comments do not supply the missing message argument. This is a static source observation, not evidence of a runtime failure or an accepted style convention. Keep unrelated assertions outside the requested change unchanged.

Scope: Message deletion test assertions.
